policy: Every .svg and .png file in the realistic asset directory must carry a disposition. An unclassified asset is a lint failure; an intentionally unused asset is not. reachabilityTags are re-derived by the checker and must agree with the declared disposition.

nonAssetEntries.name: blender-lab-bench
nonAssetEntries.rationale: Blender render sources (beaker-250ml.png, erlenmeyer-flask-250ml.png) staged beside the published assets. Not rendered by the app and deliberately not registered; recorded here so a future asset cannot hide inside it unnoticed.

dispositions.player-active: Selected by realisticAssetById in src/equipment/catalog.ts for at least one equipment definition.
dispositions.accessory-active: Selected by a presentation-only accessory contract in src/equipment/visualCatalog.ts; it creates no equipment definition or runtime visual state.
dispositions.state-active: Selected through stateAssets in src/equipment/visualCatalog.ts. CAL-01 through CAL-12 are registered but no content authors the matching visualState yet.
dispositions.composite-active: Selected by a composite branch. Cycle 05 moves the branch into src/equipment/compositeRegistry.json.
dispositions.custom-route-active: Selected by a custom investigation player under src/investigations, not by the shared player.
dispositions.gallery-only: Referenced only by the equipment art gallery in src/trials/realisticEquipmentAssets.ts. Intentional, not debt.
dispositions.intentionally-unused: Present on disk with no code path and no planned wiring. Intentional, not debt.
dispositions.remediation-candidate: No code path reaches it, and content authors a matching visualState. Wiring is owned by the named cycle.
